task.title: Add least-privilege supervisor-bound auto-integrator unblock authority

owned: focused publisher and supervisor contract tests
not_changing: worker lease admission or local Human/Ops authority
review decision lifecycle and GitHub merge gate

request_bindings: canonical PR and exact head SHA
authority.retry_behavior: content-addressed publisher and existing-task consumer checks are idempotent
authority.runtime_binding_source: resolve_execute_authority-proven promoted command root HEAD carried in immutable Settings; no cron environment dependency
authority.task_id_derivation: shared producer/consumer contract; values over 96 characters use a deterministic SHA-256 suffix to prevent truncation collisions

consumer_isolation.transaction_scope: one authoritative TaskStore transaction per request
consumer_isolation.source_finalization: move each consumed request to its outcome-specific durable archive
consumer_isolation.failure_semantics: malformed or failed request does not prevent a later request from being attempted

review_reopen_resolution.resolved_defect: The publisher now receives its runtime SHA from the already-proven execute authority even when cron exports no runtime-SHA environment variable. Publisher and consumer share one pure unblock contract, and long generated task IDs use a deterministic digest suffix instead of colliding raw truncation.
review_reopen_resolution.regression_guard: No-environment execute-authority publication, producer/consumer equality, <=96-character bounds, and explicit distinct-long-reason non-collision are covered alongside the existing authority and materialization suites.
